points.description: States that multiple hidden layers are desirable when deeper/more complex learning or feature extraction is needed (complex, hierarchical or non-trivial features must be learned).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says for complex problems without mentioning features or learning depth.

points.description: Gives a suitable example or circumstance, such as non-linearly separable problems like XOR, or multiclass classification, or says more layers help perform further tasks well.
points.partial_credit: Half if a relevant but vague example/circumstance is given (e.g. 'complicated data').

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying that multiple hidden layers are used when complex problems need deeper feature learning, in any wording, plus any sensible example (XOR, multiclass classification, non-linear problems). Part marks for a vague but relevant answer such as 'for complex data' without detail. No marks for unrelated or wrong answers; extra remarks do not cost marks.
